name: xl3-standard
description: xl3 — an open standard for declarative Excel transformation. This is the repository root; the JavaScript/TypeScript reference implementation lives in impl/js (published to npm as @xl3-lang/xl3).

scripts.lint: eslint impl/js/src website/src website/docusaurus.config.ts website/sidebars.ts scripts conformance/scripts examples/scripts --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write "impl/js/src/**/*.ts" "website/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" website/docusaurus.config.ts website/sidebars.ts "scripts/**/*.mjs" "conformance/scripts/**/*.mjs" "examples/scripts/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.js package.json impl/js/package.json impl/js/public-runtime-exports.json examples/expected-output.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "impl/js/src/**/*.ts" "website/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" website/docusaurus.config.ts website/sidebars.ts "scripts/**/*.mjs" "conformance/scripts/**/*.mjs" "examples/scripts/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.js package.json impl/js/package.json impl/js/public-runtime-exports.json examples/expected-output.json
scripts.conformance:tz: TZ=UTC npm run conformance && TZ=America/New_York npm run conformance && TZ=Asia/Seoul npm run conformance
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:sync && cd website && docusaurus start
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:sync && cd website && docusaurus build
scripts.operational:regression: npm run examples:build && npm run examples:run
